notes: Every value is an integer number of centavos or a decimal rate. `status` is one of verified | secondary | memory | placeholder. `source` points at a URL or at the research note that carries the citation. scripts/check-data.ts refuses a release build while any parameter is memory or placeholder.

minimumWage.note: Decreto 12.797 of 23/12/2025, art. 1: R$ 1.621,00, daily R$ 54,04, hourly R$ 7,37, in force 01/01/2026. Sao Paulo state floor is R$ 1.874,36 from 01/06/2026 (Lei estadual 18.471/2026, per search results; not opened), used only by categories without a federal piso. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

inssRateBand1.note: First INSS band, up to one minimum wage

valeTransporteRate.note: Decreto 95.247/1987 art. 9 (Senate legislation portal): the beneficiary pays 'a parcela equivalente a 6% de seu salário básico ou vencimento' and the employer pays the excess. Same rule in Lei 7.418/1985 (art. 4, parágrafo único; Planalto blocked the fetch). Search results say the decree was revoked by Decreto 10.854/2021, whose art. 114 repeats the 6% (not opened). The base is salário básico, excluding adicionais. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

cardRotativoMonthly.note: BCB average 451,7% a.a. for rotativo, Sep 2026 (published 29 Oct 2026, Agência Estado). (1+4,517)^(1/12)-1 = 15,29%/month. BCB page itself could not be rendered. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

cardParceladoMonthly.note: BCB average 193,0% a.a. for parcelado, Sep 2026. (2,93)^(1/12)-1 = 9,37%/month. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

cardCapMultiple.note: Lei 14.690/2023 + CMN Res. 5.112/2023: interest and charges cannot exceed 100% of the original debt; IOF excluded

cardMinimumPaymentPct.note: Mobills (4 Jan 2024) describes the issuer minimum as 15% of the statement plus 100% of interest, IOF, late fees and withdrawals. Nubank's help page (nubank.com.br/ajuda-e-seguranca/rotativo-e-parcelamento) shows R$ 130 on a R$ 725 bill (17.9%, charges included) without stating a rule. No bank page found stating its own percentage; 15% is the representative share. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

cardFirstLimit.note: Design choice: a first card at R$ 500. Nubank publishes no initial limit; its deposit-backed route goes up to R$ 5.000 (notes). Searched Nubank, Itau, Bradesco pages and press, 2026-11.

chequeEspecialMonthly.note: Kept as the legal cap (CMN Res. 4.765/2019, 8%/month; cap text not re-opened, PDF unreadable). BCB Sep 2026 average is 139,0% a.a. = 7,53%/month (Estadão via Paiquerê FM, 29 Oct 2026), just under the cap. Use 0.0753 if the game should show the average rather than the ceiling. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

personalLoanMonthly.note: BCB average 110,9% a.a. for non-consigned personal credit, Sep 2026 (Aug 110,4%). (2,109)^(1/12)-1 = 6,42%/month. Procon-SP's 8,66% a.m. at big banks (earlier note) not re-verified. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

consignadoMonthly.note: BCB average for consignado privado (CLT) 55,5% a.a. in Sep 2026 (Aug 56,3%). (1,555)^(1/12)-1 = 3,75%/month; consistent with 3,79%/month reported for June 2026. Old value 3,4% was from mid-2025. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

motoFinanceMonthly.note: Blogs quoting Banco Honda 1.49% / Santander 1.57% a.m.; CET not confirmed

selicAnnual.note: Copom 282nd meeting, 4 Nov 2026: Selic held at 13,75% a.a., unanimous (communiqué reproduced by Atlas Publico; Rankia confirms and says target in force since 16 Sep). bcb.gov.br pages did not render, so not verified. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

cdiAnnual.note: Rankia: CDI 'perto de 13,65% a.a.' after the Nov 2026 hold. CDI trades about 0,10 pp under Selic. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

poupancaMonthly.note: Rankia: credit of 0,6624% on 1 Nov 2026 (0,5% + TR of 0,1616% for 1 Oct to 1 Nov, BCB TR). Rule 0,5%+TR holds while Selic > 8,5%. Rounded from 0,006624. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

tesouroCustodyExemptUpTo.note: Tesouro Selic exempt on the first R$ 10.000 per CPF

cdbPctCdi.note: Fintech caixinhas pay 100% CDI (some promos up to 120%)

irFixedIncome0to6.note: Regressive IR table, up to 180 days

ipcaExpected.note: Focus bulletin of 2 Nov 2026 (data to 30 Oct): IPCA 2026 median 5,22%, 2027 4,76% (above the 4,5% ceiling), Selic end-2026 13,50%, end-2027 12,50%. Value for 2026 unchanged; 2027 is 0.0476 if needed. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

mesadaMonthly.note: Serasa/Opinion Box (Oct 2023): 74% of paying parents give up to R$ 100 and 53% up to R$ 60; sample size not published. SPC Brasil is cited in search snippets at an average of about R$ 123 (page not opened). The 2024 wave (61% up to R$ 100) is in docs/research/notes/tween_teen_money_life.md and was not re-opened here. R$ 100 is the documented ceiling for most payers. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

lanchePrice.note: No São Paulo school-cantina list was found. Proxy: the UFMG engineering-school cantina contract price list readjusted 23/04/2026 has pão de queijo R$ 3,05, coxinha R$ 5,44, juice box R$ 4,46, soda can R$ 5,44, so salgado plus drink is R$ 7,51 to R$ 10,90; R$ 9 sits in that range. Raised from R$ 4: 20 days at R$ 9 is R$ 180, above a R$ 100 mesada, which is the intended dilemma. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

schoolDaysPerMonth.note: LDB (Lei 9.394/1996) art. 24, I: minimum 800 hours over at least 200 days of effective school work, excluding final exams. 200 days over about 10 school months is 20 days per month. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

jovemAprendizPay4h.note: Decreto 12.797/2025 sets the hourly minimum at R$ 7,37; apprentice pay is at least the hourly minimum (CLT art. 428 par. 2; Decreto 9.579/2018 regulates the contract; neither opened). R$ 7,37 x 100h/month (4h x 5 days x 20 weeks, Genyo method) = R$ 737. Brief's 22-day formula gives R$ 648,56; with DSR (Caltrab) ~R$ 761. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

peDeMeiaMonthly.note: Attendance incentive; up to R$ 9.200 over three years

cestaBasicaSP.note: DIEESE bulletin dated 9 Oct 2026, read as text: São Paulo R$ 922,51 in September (+2,43% on August), the most expensive capital. The October bulletin (202610cestabasica.pdf) returned 404 on 8 Nov 2026, so September is the latest. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

busFareSP.note: SPTrans municipal bus basic fare rose from R$ 5,00 to R$ 5,30 on 06/01/2026 (Diário do Transporte). SPTrans' own page was not opened. No later change was found. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

rentKitnetSP.note: QuintoAndar kitnet/studio neighbourhood averages in São Paulo (listing-based, not an official survey): Sé R$ 1.520, Mooca R$ 1.800, Liberdade R$ 1.840, Aclimação R$ 2.125, Vila Mariana R$ 2.750. FipeZAP April 2026: R$ 64,20/m2 in São Paulo, so a 30 m2 one-bedroom is R$ 1.926 (viva.com.br/dinheiro/maior-demanda-por-aluguel-na-cidade-de-sao-paulo-encarece-compactos.html). R$ 1.500 is the cheapest central average; peripheral units are cheaper but unsourced. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

phonePlan.note: Comparator page dated 21/09/2026: typical prepaid at R$ 30 per 30 days (Claro Prezão 21GB, Vivo Pré 25GB, TIM Pré Xip 16GB). Controle starts at R$ 49,90 to R$ 59,90 (melhorplano.net/planos-de-celular/plano-controle, updated 06/11/2026). Operator price pages were not opened. Lowered from R$ 50 because the key describes a prepaid plan. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

entryPhonePrice.note: TechTudo, 11/09/2026: Galaxy A17 128GB R$ 999 on Amazon (offer card; text says R$ 849) and R$ 1.081,52 on Magalu; Moto G35 256GB R$ 899 to R$ 1.199. Value is the Amazon A17 offer-card price. The old R$ 1.366 was the Redmi Note 15, which is mid-range, not entry. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

pixDiscountTypical.note: GMattos survey (July 2024, Seu Dinheiro 12 Sep 2024): 58% of retailers gave Pix advantages; 3-5% across all products at many stores, 10-15% on some groups, up to 20% on some items. Coupon guide for Magalu (cupomonline.com.br/cupom-magazine-luiza-pix/) says 5-15%. 5% is the typical store-wide figure. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

motoPrice.note: Honda's own site returned 403. Garagem360 (16/01/2026) reports a suggested price of R$ 15.780 for the CG 160 Start 2026 excluding freight, and says dealer prices run R$ 2.000 to R$ 3.000 higher. Other outlets cite R$ 16.770 and R$ 17.350 (the figure kept from the repo notes, from A Revista, which now redirects to a 404). R$ 17.350 sits between suggested price and dealer price. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

privateTuitionMonthly.note: Hoper study via ABMES: median presencial private fee actually charged in 2026 is R$ 835 (net of discounts). Medicina is the outlier (median R$ 11,4 mil per the repo note). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

eadTuitionMonthly.note: Hoper study via ABMES: median EAD fee actually charged in 2026 is R$ 214 (net of discounts). Semesp's average is higher (R$ 317 in 1st semester 2025, different method). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

tecnicoTuitionMonthly.note: Quero Bolsa (09/09/2026): private presencial técnico R$ 300-600/month, EaD ~R$ 400, course ~2 years; value is the R$ 450 midpoint. ETEC/IF are free; SENAC SP advertises fixed installments (page not readable here, so no price taken). Not an SP-specific price list. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

cursinhoMonthly.note: Kept at R$ 800. Educa Mais Brasil guide ('Media de valores em 2026', presencial Enem course): 'Mensalidade: entre R$ 400 e R$ 1.200', annual package R$ 4.500-12.000; R$ 800 is the midpoint. Checked against 2026/2027 price lists read 09/11/2026: Cursinho da Poli SP Extensivo seg-sex 'a partir de R$475,40 por mes' (ter-qui R$ 361,58, sabados R$ 303,26), Maximize SP manha R$ 607 x14 (noite R$ 527), Bernoulli BH Extensivo 2026 manha R$ 38.290/year + R$ 4.628 material (~R$ 3.576/month, elite end); Anglo R$ 164-1.203 and Objetivo R$ 900-2.000 are 2023 figures. Anglo, Etapa, Objetivo and Poliedro publish no 2026 price list online. Online is far cheaper: Descomplica Enem 2027 12x R$ 49,90, Estrategia 12x R$ 70-100. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/secondary-pass.md]

salaryAuxAdmin.note: Salario.com.br (updated 05/11/2026, CAGED 12 months): auxiliar administrativo listed at R$ 2.099 average; assistente administrativo R$ 2.476. The auxiliar page itself reports R$ 2.079-2.099 (page figures differ slightly). Was R$ 2.200. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

salaryTecnicoEnfermagem.note: Salario.com.br (updated 05/11/2026, CAGED CLT base pay): average R$ 2.559,99, median R$ 2.423. The old value R$ 3.325 is the legal piso (Lei 14.434/2022), which real hiring does not follow; game designer must decide which to use. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

salaryDevJunior.note: Salario.com.br (05/11/2026, CAGED): programador piso R$ 3.459, median R$ 4.631, average R$ 6.104 (junior breakdown is paywalled). The entry-level proxy is the piso, which is close to the old Glassdoor R$ 3.463. Top firms pay much more (Robert Half p50 R$ 6.850 per repo note). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

salaryEnfermeiro.note: Salario.com.br (updated 05/11/2026, CAGED Oct 2025-Sep 2026): average R$ 4.493,35, reference piso R$ 3.684,45 at 38h/week. Legal national piso is R$ 4.750 (Lei 14.434/2022), the old value; not universally applied. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

salaryProfessor.note: Kept: national piso for public basic-education teachers, R$ 5.130,63 for 40h (MEC Portaria 82/2026, per Conexao TO cited in the repo note; not re-opened here). Private CLT hiring is much lower: Salario.com.br shows Professor I Ensino Fundamental ~R$ 3.354 at 30h (search result, not opened). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

salaryIfood.note: Serasa (27/05/2026) citing iFood: gross R$ 28/hour worked in 2024; iFood says more than R$ 2.500/month at ~4h/day; Serasa's example of 6h x 20 days = R$ 3.360 gross (R$ 28 x 6 x 20, an estimate). Gross only: fuel, maintenance and insurance not deducted (Cebrap ~R$ 700/month maintenance per repo note). Was R$ 2.400; designer may keep that as the net-ish figure. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

medioPremium.note: IPEA TD 2804 (Oferta de escolas e retorno do ensino medio): completing ensino medio is associated with a wage return of 11% to 20% depending on instrument. 0.15 is a game design choice inside that range. Raw IBGE gap by education could not be extracted. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

tecnicoPremium.note: IPEA TD 2859 (Retorno da educacao tecnica): wage premium of 21,3% to 24,9% for workers in technical occupations (RAIS longitudinal, 2007-2018 data). 0.23 is a design choice inside the range; smaller for 18-year-olds. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

degreePremium.note: Design choice: a conservative causal premium (Insper 2018 dissertation, cited in the repo note, finds >25%; not re-opened). Raw PNAD gap is far larger: graduates earn 126% more than ensino medio (Mackenzie/IBGE headline); IBGE 2025 puts superior completo at R$ 6.947 (Bahia Noticias) but the medio figure was not found. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

comprometimentoYellow.note: Record 29.0% of income to debt service, Aug 2026

comprometimentoRed.note: BCB alert threshold for Pix credit (Res. 601-603/2026)

phoneTheftAnnualProb.note: SSP: 161.666 phones robbed or stolen in São Paulo city in 2025 (254.416 statewide). City population 11.904.961 (IBGE 2025 estimate, via abcdoabc.com.br) gives 1.36% per person; statewide 254.416 / 46.081.801 = 0.55%. Counts are police reports (undercount) and can include repeat victims and non-residents, so 1.4% for the city is an approximation. Was 3%. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

betsExpectedLoss.unit: share of stake lost per month
betsExpectedLoss.note: Itaú study (Jul 2023 to Jun 2024, via O Antagonista): deposits R$ 68,2 bn, withdrawals R$ 44,3 bn, net loss R$ 23,9 bn = 35% of deposits ('R$ 1 lost per R$ 3'). Comsefaz (Agência Brasil/O Povo, 6 Aug 2026): R$ 62,5 bn lost in 2025, R$ 4,7 bn/month, using BCB Pix data; it gives no deposit-loss share. Fortune Tiger RTP is reported as 96,81% by affiliate and press sites, not confirmed by PG Soft. The game applies the 35% as the share lost; it is a yearly aggregate used as a monthly proxy, so treat as a design simplification. Was 60%. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

healthPlanYoung.note: Company Hero simulator (checked 21/10/2026), Sao Paulo, age 24-28: cheapest R$ 197,61 per person for a 1-life MEI plan, R$ 149,63 for plans with 3+ lives. These are coletivo/empresarial starting prices; individual plans are rarely sold (Bradesco sells none). Was R$ 145 (ages 19-23). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

negativacaoYears.note: Negative listing removed 5 years after due date

familyContribution.note: Design choice. SPC Brasil/CNDL (article of 13/02/2017): 83% of 18-30 year-olds help pay household expenses; 29% cover part and 27% are the main provider. No amount in reais was found in any source. R$ 400 is about 25% of the 2026 minimum wage of R$ 1.621. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

motoRunningCost.note: Garagem360 (21/01/2026), about 1.000 km a month, 35-45 km/l, gasoline about R$ 6,00: fuel R$ 150-180, insurance R$ 110-135 (R$ 1.300-1.600 a year), IPVA and licensing R$ 50-55, maintenance R$ 200-260; total R$ 510-630, midpoint R$ 570. At about 400 km a month the same inputs give roughly R$ 300. Raised from R$ 250 assuming delivery-type use. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

overdraftFloor.note: Design choice: the game caps cheque especial at one month of income or R$ 500, whichever is larger. No bank publishes a minimum pre-approved limit; searched 2026-11.

usedPhonePrice.note: Used Galaxy A54 5G (2023 mid-range): Trocafone refurbished about R$ 908 to R$ 1.153 on Magalu and R$ 1.037 (Pix) on Casas Bahia/Extra; OLX private ads about R$ 800 to R$ 1.200; Mercado Livre R$ 850 and up. Listing pages return 403 to the fetch tool, so prices come from search-result snippets and are not page-verified. R$ 800 is the private-listing low end. Note this is close to a new Galaxy A17. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

giftGrandma.note: Design choice. No survey of cash gifts from grandparents exists. Reference range: Datafolha/Abecs average planned Dia das Crianças gift R$ 231 (2024); the 2025 and 2026 editions are reported at R$ 219 and R$ 225 in search snippets; a gift guide's bands for ages 10-12 run R$ 30 to R$ 150. R$ 100 sits inside that range. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

giftBirthdayUnit.note: Design choice. One unit is R$ 100, so a gift is R$ 100 to R$ 200. Reference: the top band for ages 10-12 in the gift guide is R$ 70 to R$ 150 (the guide's own suggestions); Datafolha/Abecs average R$ 231 (2024). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

mesadaYearlyStep.note: Design choice. No survey gives mesada by age (Serasa 2023 gives only the share of payers: 54% at 6-11, 45% at 15-18). The repo notes' inference is R$ 50-100 at 10-14 and R$ 100-150 at 15-17. From R$ 100 at 10, R$ 10 per year gives R$ 150 at 15 and R$ 170 at 17. The old R$ 20 per year reached R$ 240 at 17, above any sourced figure. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

gameDiamondsPrice.note: Free Fire diamond packs run R$ 3 to R$ 50+; R$ 30 is a mid pack (official Pix price list, Nov 2026)

bicoWeekPay.note: Design choice backed by computation. Salario.com.br (Nov 2026): panfleteiro CLT base R$ 1.862,80 to R$ 2.756 a month, average R$ 9,72 per hour, so about 15 hours a week is R$ 146. Day rates seen: freelance garçom R$ 120 for 18h-01h in Campinas (bne.com.br/vaga-de-emprego-na-area-alimentos-em-campinas-sp/garcom/4654395, undated); Recife leafleting R$ 70 per 4h shift and São Paulo babá about R$ 27 per hour appear only in search snippets. No São Paulo teen-specific source exists, and minors under 16 cannot legally work. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

securedCardMinSavings.note: Nubank 16-17 secured card: limit equals the Caixinha balance; minimum not published

securedCardMaxLimit.note: Game design choice. Real rule (Nubank, ages 16-17): limit equals the Caixinha balance, no published maximum or minimum, unpaid bills are settled from the Caixinha. Nubank's deposit-backed limit route tops out at R$ 5.000 (Mobills 2023), so R$ 1.000 sits inside the R$ 0 to R$ 5.000 real range. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

betsStake.note: BCB 2024: youngest bettors spend about R$ 100 a month; R$ 50 is the game's entry stake

promotionBonus.note: Design choice. Abrasel-SP expects an average ticket of R$ 120 per person for end-of-year events in São Paulo bars and restaurants (article of 13/12/2025). A São Paulo full lunch averaged R$ 59,67 in the 2024 ABBT/Mosaiclab survey. R$ 200 is about four people at R$ 50, below the festive peak. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

emergencyMinCost.note: Einstein PS consultation R$ 600 to R$ 1.000 (broker article, 6 Jul 2024, repeating the hospital's own FAQ, which returned 403 here). Exams are billed separately and not priced in the source. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

emergencyMaxCost.note: Design choice at the low end of a wide range. Ikaros (Aug 2026) estimates an entry fee of R$ 1.500 to R$ 3.500 at high-complexity SP hospitals, exams and medication billed on top; it is a market estimate, not an official Einstein price. Consider raising if the game should reflect Einstein-class cost. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

blackFridayPixDiscount.note: Design choice inside the observed range: Magalu Pix discount 5-15% depending on product and promotion (coupon site, 2026); GMattos 2024 found 10-15% on selected groups. No 2026 retailer page quoting a Black Friday Pix percentage was found. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

blackFridayMinCash.note: Design choice. Helloo (Aug 2026, n=600): 66% expect to spend over R$ 500 on Black Friday. A Stefanini ticket of R$ 790,71 per order appears only in search snippets. R$ 1.000 sits above both and about equals the entry phone (R$ 999), the likely big-ticket offer; the game should keep it at or above the cheapest offer's price. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

familyPixAmount.note: Design choice. Nubank study via Forbes (29 Sep 2025): 84% of under-18 users use Pix for transfers and 64% of young clients send R$ 20 or less. That describes teen-to-teen transfers, not a loan from family; R$ 200 is a deliberately larger 'family loan' above the usual R$ 20 transfer. No survey of family loan size found. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

consignadoAmount.note: MTE data (early Apr 2025): average R$ 6.240,57 per worker, installment R$ 349,20, 18 months; margin up to 35% of net income. Computation for a minimum-wage worker (R$ 1.621, Decreto 12.797/2025): net about R$ 1.500, 35% margin about R$ 525/month, which at 3.75%/month supports about R$ 6.800 over 18 months. Changed from R$ 5.000 to R$ 6.000 (game value rounds the average). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/credit.md]

bfPriceTv.note: Samsung Crystal UHD U8600F 50 pol 4K, R$ 1.982 no Pix (Mercado Livre, Canaltech 29/12/2025); same article: LG 50UA85 R$ 2.019, TCL 50P7K QLED R$ 2.089. Cheaper outlier ignored: Hisense 50Q6QV R$ 1.189 on 27/11/2025 (Promobit). Range for mainstream brands R$ 1.900-2.100. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

bfPriceCelular.note: iPhone 16 256 GB averaged R$ 5.300 in the weeks around Black Friday 2025 (R$ 4.800 on 27/11, R$ 4.700 on 29/11 one-off), per Canaltech 18/10/2026. iPhone 17 256 GB sells at R$ 5.400-5.800 in Oct 2026, so the value also fits the current base iPhone. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

bfPriceVideogame.note: PS5 Slim Digital appeared at about R$ 2.700 during Black Friday 2025 (TecMundo, 25-28/11/2025). Promobit's best of the week was R$ 2.299 (Magalu bundle, 27/11) and disc model R$ 2.749. Prices are higher in late 2026 (Promobit PS5 page lists R$ 2.879 for the Digital), so BF 2026 may come in above this. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

bfPriceFone.note: Apple AirPods Pro 2 sold for about R$ 1.500 in Oct 2025 and Canaltech calls R$ 200-300 off a good Black Friday deal, so about R$ 1.200-1.300. This is an editorial target, not an observed BF price. No Brazilian BF price found for Sony WH-1000XM5. AirPods Pro 3 list R$ 2.699 (TecMundo 10/10/2025). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

bfPriceTenis.note: Nike's own store in Black Friday 2024 (27/11/2024), with the EXTRA15 coupon at Pix: SB Dunk Low Pro R$ 565,24, Dunk Low Twist R$ 565,24, Women's Dunk Low SE R$ 541,02. No dated BF 2025 Dunk/Samba/AJ1 price found; a Promobit Nike offer (ended, undated) shows Dunk Low Retro Premium R$ 559,99 from R$ 1.099,99. Real range roughly R$ 540-1.100. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

bfPriceNotebook.note: Dell Inspiron 15 (Core i5-1334U, 8 GB, SSD 512 GB) at R$ 2.584,99 on 26/11/2025; Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 (Ryzen 7, 8 GB, 512 GB) R$ 2.421 on 27/11/2025 (Promobit, BF week 24-30/11/2025). Same Dell costs R$ 3.389,05 in the last 30 days of Oct-Nov 2026. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

bfPriceAirfryer.note: Lowest prices of BF week 24-30/11/2025 on Promobit: Elgin Quad Fry 4,2 L R$ 127,92; Mondial AFN-40 4 L R$ 149 (28/11); Midea Widemax 4,5 L R$ 172. Picked the middle one. Mondial AFN-40 was R$ 189,75 in the 30 days before the page was published (Nov 2026). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/blackfriday.md]

leisureTeenMonthly.note: Design choice. Serasa Custos de Vida (fieldwork 22/12/2025-06/01/2026, n=6.063, among respondents who have the expense): national average lazer R$ 340 a month, São Paulo R$ 390, eating out R$ 250 national and R$ 310 SP. No teen breakdown. R$ 350 is the national lazer average; a teen's roupa and rolê share is assumed similar. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

leisureAdultMonthly.note: Serasa Custos de Vida Jan 2026 (n=6.063): lazer R$ 390 in São Paulo (R$ 340 national), personal-care services R$ 150 national, eating out R$ 310 SP. R$ 400 equals the SP lazer average alone, so lazer, roupa and barbearia together are a conservative game figure. IBGE POF 2017-2018 (Tabela 5, opened): vestuário 4,3% and recreação e cultura 2,6% of mean monthly family consumption of R$ 3.764,51, about R$ 162 and R$ 98 in 2018 reais, as a cross-check. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/household.md]

lifestyleEconomicoFactor.note: Design knob: the "econômico" lifestyle spends half the base and costs 5 wellbeing points of drift target

lifestyleFolgadoFactor.note: Design knob: the "folgado" lifestyle spends 1.6x the base and gains 5 wellbeing points of drift target

reserveMultipleBigPurchase.note: Paying a Black Friday item à vista is only offered when liquid savings cover twice the price (keeps a reserve)

reserveMultipleMoto.note: Buying the moto à vista is only offered when liquid savings cover 1.5x the price

childMonthlyCost.note: sum.money (updated April 2026, citing IBGE/SPC/FGV): lower-income family with public school and SUS spends R$ 1.200-1.600/month on a child; midpoint R$ 1.400. Component breakdown not given. Diapers R$ 150-420/month and formula ~R$ 400/month appear in other search results (not opened). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

usedCarPrice.note: FIPE for a 2018 Fiat Mobi (8 years old), reference October 2026: R$ 37.588 to R$ 45.613 by version; a median near R$ 39.845 is reported. Rounded to R$ 40.000. FIPE read via an aggregator; Gol and HB20 not checked (HB20 2018 is R$ 63-68k). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

carFinanceMonthly.note: BCB SGS API (opened): monthly series returns 1,96% (Sep 2026), 1,97% (Aug), 1,98% (Jul). Matches SGS 20749 (annual rate for aquisicao de veiculos, PF) of 26,18% a.a. in Sep 2026 = 1,96%/month compounded. This is the average for all vehicle credit, not used-car only. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

carFinanceMonths.note: Design choice: 48 months (the brief's 48-or-60). Garagem360 simulates a 48-month Tabela Price loan at the BCB average rate (26,42% a.a. in Aug 2026); it does not state a typical term, and no BCB term series was read. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

carRunningCost.note: Canaltech (04/04/2026), entry hatch at 1.200 km/month: fuel R$ 500 + insurance R$ 150 + IPVA R$ 220 + maintenance R$ 200 = R$ 1.070. Adjusted for a R$ 40k car: IPVA SP 4% = R$ 133/month, giving ~R$ 983, rounded to R$ 1.000. Vrum (03/08/2026) cites R$ 1.632 for a popular car including protection and washing (upper bound). IPVA rate is from search results, not opened. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

weddingCostSimple.note: Only the civil part is official: ARPEN-SP Tabela V (Registro Civil das Pessoas Naturais) 2026, 'Em vigor a partir de 08/01/2026', item 1 'Lavratura de assento de casamento realizado na sede ... exceto os custos de editais': R$ 480,25 emolumentos + R$ 96,05 Estado = R$ 576,30 (sem ISS; ISS adds 1-5% where levied). Habilitacao for a wedding at another serventia is a separate R$ 392,05. Free for couples who declare poverty (Codigo Civil art. 1.512 par. unico; procedure in CNJ Provimento 221/2026). The ~R$ 4.400 small celebration is still a design assumption with no source, so the R$ 5.000 total stays secondary. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/secondary-pass.md]

weddingCostParty.note: Casamentos.com.br (2025 report, couples married 2024): Sao Paulo average R$ 54.947 for ~124 guests = ~R$ 443/guest; at 65 guests ~R$ 28,8k. Zankyou via Neon: SP economico R$ 40 mil per 100 guests (~R$ 400/guest, ~R$ 26k at 65). Value R$ 28.000 computed. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

tripCost.note: Computed: Anac average fare R$ 660 (Jun 2026; R$ 703 in Jul per Panrotas) x 2 legs = ~R$ 1.360, plus 4 nights at the Fohb national average daily rate R$ 421 (Jun 2026) = R$ 1.684; total ~R$ 3.040, rounded R$ 3.000. Food and local transport excluded. No Decolar/Hurb data found. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

englishCourseMonthly.note: Wizard (30/09/2026): from R$ 277/month up to R$ 742 by unit, promo 12 x R$ 279. Fisk SP (page dated 2024, 2026 range R$ 250-400): R$ 283/month plus material R$ 725/semester (~R$ 121/month). Value R$ 400 = fee + material. Catraca Livre (22/01/2026) gives R$ 200-600 for presencial group classes. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

englishPremium.note: Catho survey, 2nd half of 2024, relayed in a Jiveworld press release (17/12/2024): average salary gap of fluent vs non-speakers by level 'Tecnico (49%); Analista (58%); Operacional (133%); Especialista (51%)', 'Supervisores/Coordenadores (78%); e Gerente/Diretor (164%)'. Raw gaps, not causal (confounded with education and employer). 0.25 kept as a conservative premium, about half the technician/analyst gap, same discount logic as degreePremium. Catho's own report page was not found; no Robert Half or IBGE-based percentage exists. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/secondary-pass.md]

fgtsRate.note: Lei 8.036/1990 art. 15: employer deposits 8% of the remuneration paid or due (PGFN page opened). Apprentices get 2% (search result, unverified), so the game should use 0.02 for the aprendiz job. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

fgtsFineRate.note: Fine on dismissal without cause is 40% of the FGTS balance (Lei 8.036/1990 art. 18 par. 1; raised from 10% by CF/88 ADCT art. 10, I, per PGFN page). It is 20% for culpa reciproca or forca maior. Paid on the whole balance, not on salary. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

seguroDesempregoMonthsMin.note: MTE page: 3 parcelas for 9-11 months worked (2nd request) or 6-11 months (3rd+); a first request needs 12+ months and gets no 3-parcela tier. Lei 7.998/1990 art. 4 sets the 3-5 range. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

seguroDesempregoMonthsMax.note: MTE page: 4 parcelas for 12-23 months worked, 5 for 24 months or more, within the last 36 months. Game rule: 3 if 6-11 months, 4 if 12-23, 5 if 24+ (simplification of the first-request rule). [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/education.md]

seguroDesempregoMax.note: MTE (gov.br, published 12/01/2026): table 'com vigencia a partir de 11 de janeiro de 2026'; 'Acima de R$ 3.703,99 - O valor sera invariavel de R$ 2.518,65'; up to R$ 2.222,17 x 0,8; R$ 2.222,18-3.703,99 = R$ 1.777,74 + 0,5 x excess; floor is the R$ 1.621,00 minimum wage. Basis Lei 7.998/1990 and Resolucao CODEFAT 957/2022, INPC 3,90%. The R$ 2.587,47 seen on some sites is wrong. [notes: docs/research/notes/verification-2026-11/secondary-pass.md]

layoffAnnualProb.note: Design knob: chance per year that a CLT job ends without just cause. CAGED turnover is far higher; the game keeps it rare so a layoff is an event, not noise
